wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Market News, Nov. 13, 2026: Nvidia Shares Drop Again as Investors Eye Fallout From Huang's Removal
wsjHeadlines.description: AI trade faces major tests next week with chip giant's earnings and Anthropic's IPO

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech Stocks Fall as Next Week Brings Big Tests for the AI Trade
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Nvidia closes lower and Anthropic CEO hopes IPO will “overdeliver.”

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Chief Tells Jamie Dimon He Hopes IPO Will ‘Underpromise and Overdeliver’
wsjHeadlines.description: The artificial-intelligence giant, which is expected to begin trading Thursday, is targeting a valuation of roughly $1.33 trillion or more.

wsjHeadlines.title: Cravath Employee Is Charged With Insider Trading Using Confidential Deal Information
wsjHeadlines.description: Prosecutors said the employee netted $70,000 in profits related to client matters including Paramount’s acquisition of Warner Bros.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Stock Market’s Bargain Bin Is Secretly Stuffed With AI Stocks
wsjHeadlines.description: Value funds don’t always offer the exposure to cheap, boring stocks that investors might expect.

wsjHeadlines.title: How the AI Trade Hijacked the Treasury Market for a Month
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Nvidia enters its next phase, and Microsoft’s global outage

wsjHeadlines.title: CVS Breakup Won’t Satisfy Washington. It Could Still Work for Wall Street.
wsjHeadlines.description: Spinning off its drugstores won’t quiet CVS’s critics, but it could leave shareholders with a more valuable company.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia Shareholders Won’t Miss Jensen Huang for Long
wsjHeadlines.description: Steadier hands could be better suited to enriching shareholders as the AI chip company enters a new phase.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia’s Disappearing Singapore Sales Deepen Mystery Around Megaspeed
wsjHeadlines.description: Last year, just as scrutiny of Megaspeed was rising, Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore revenue.

wsjHeadlines.title: CoreWeave Finds a Workaround to Capital Constraints—for Now
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s ambitious plans will still require cooperation from capital markets.

wsjHeadlines.title: A Reined In Jensen Huang Is Nvidia’s Best Option
wsjHeadlines.description: A more restrained chief would suit the chip giant well for the next phase of the AI boom.

wsjHeadlines.title: For Big Bank Stocks, Capitol Hill’s Bark Is Worse Than Its Bite
wsjHeadlines.description: Democrats’ election victory will put Wall Street critics in key seats, but the Fed holds the real power.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Bots Are Using Credit Cards. Banks Are Racing to Keep Up.
wsjHeadlines.description: Stripe is positioning itself as a key cog for agentic commerce, while JPMorgan Chase is a skeptic.

wsjHeadlines.title: Metro Bank Hangs Up ‘For Sale’ Sign
wsjHeadlines.description: The lender said Thursday that it wasn’t in any active discussions and it hadn’t received an approach for a potential takeover.

wsjHeadlines.title: SEC Enforcement Penalties Fall to 18-Year Low
wsjHeadlines.description: The Wall Street regulator obtained about $1 billion last year, the lowest amount since the 2008 financial crisis.

wsjHeadlines.title: Wall Street Pay Set to Climb After Volatile Markets and IPOs Fuel Bank Profits
wsjHeadlines.description: Traders and investment bankers are set to see among the biggest bumps in bonuses.

wsjHeadlines.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on UniCredit, Credit Agricole, Banco BPM and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

wsjHeadlines.title: Auto & Transport Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Air France-KLM, HMM and more in the latest Market Talks covering the Auto and Transport sector.

wsjHeadlines.title: Kraft Heinz Plans to Bring New Life to Old Brands
wsjHeadlines.description: Some of the best analysis and insight on investing, the wealth-management business and more.

wsjHeadlines.title: Jensen Huang Called Her ‘a Deer in the Headlights.’ Now She Runs Nvidia.
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, America’s richest retirement market, and Chris Van Hollen says he will challenge Chuck Schumer to lead Senate Democrats.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia’s Meteoric Rise, in One Chart
wsjHeadlines.description: A once-modest company soared after ChatGPT unleashed demand for its chips.

wsjHeadlines.title: Brookfield Earnings Buoyed by Fund Raising, Wealth Solutions Growth
wsjHeadlines.description: Brookfield notched stronger earnings in the third quarter as the investment firm saw strong fundraising in its asset-management operations and growth in wealth solutions.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Mixed on Nvidia Fallout Fears
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks finished mixed as rate fears resurfaced and tumult at Nvidia spilled into the wider semiconductor sector, dragging down technology indexes.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Decline as Nvidia Shares Slide Again
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks declined as the tumult surrounding Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia continues to cloud the outlook for the AI trade.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Stock Indexes Turn Positive as Oil Drops
wsjHeadlines.description: European stock indexes turned positive, reversing earlier declines, as a fall in oil prices buoyed sentiment.

wsjHeadlines.title: Asia’s Stock Rebound Fades as Nvidia Uncertainty Lingers
wsjHeadlines.description: The tentative rebound in Asia’s bruised technology stocks faded Friday afternoon as bearish sentiment overpowered the initial lift.

wsjHeadlines.title: Before His Ouster, Jensen Huang Belittled the Executive Replacing Him
wsjHeadlines.description: Interim CEO Colette Kress has questioned some Huang dealmaking. He called her “a deer in the headlights.”

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Congressional Insider Trading Isn’t as Common as You Think
wsjHeadlines.description: As with Mr. Pelosi’s Alphabet options, many insider-trading claims fall apart under scrutiny.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | ‘Peer-to-Peer’ Wagering Isn’t Gambling? Don’t Bet on It
wsjHeadlines.description: Kalshi says it is different from a sportsbook. Utah says Kalshi’s own trading arm acts like the house.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Building Wealth Requires More Than Charity
wsjHeadlines.description: Handouts can’t scale to a whole nation. A market-based path to ownership can.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The U.K. Aims Sanctions at Israel, Hits the Cayman Islands
wsjHeadlines.description: Measures against the Jewish state’s banks could damage the financial-services industry in the British territory.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Trump, the New Congress and the Solyndra Probe
wsjHeadlines.description: The administration’s equity stakes in U.S. companies are about to draw legislative scrutiny.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | There’s No Such Thing as a Stock-Market Bubble
wsjHeadlines.description: In 1999, just as today, when share prices fall, it isn’t a delusion correcting. It’s uncertainty resolving.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Next Wave of Food Inflation Is Coming
wsjHeadlines.description: Grocery prices could increase again as surging energy costs and supply-chain delays are lifting costs for producers.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Futures End Week Lower
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures settled mixed with Brent practically unchanged and WTI off 0.2%, but both benchmarks saw a second straight weekly decline.

wsjHeadlines.title: Basic Materials Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on gold futures, Press Metal Aluminium, Evolution Mining and more in the latest Market Talks covering basic materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Relinquish Some Gains
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures settled lower, giving back the previous day’s weather-driven gains as a spell of cold weather is set to lift near-term heating demand.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold, Silver Futures Post Weekly Losses
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold futures held their ground in choppy trading as a below-estimate U.S. producer price reading and steadying oil prices ease inflation concerns that sank the metals the previous session.

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Rises 0.84% This Week to 98.34
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index rose 0.2%, up for four consecutive trading days.

wsjHeadlines.title: Bitcoin Holds Below $70,000 as Risk-Off Mood Pressures Crypto
wsjHeadlines.description: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time since August and was on track for its sixth weekly loss as expectations of higher rates and the tech stock selloff sapped risk appetite.
